title: CheckpointRecord
description: The provenance record of one frozen checkpoint (ADR-010 §5, protocol C7): who it came from, what it trained against and on, and under which run it was made. The C1/C6 checker computes seen or held out and independence from these records alone. The sorted and unique arrays and the self-reference rules are enforced by the reader (the contract profile has no uniqueItems and cannot compare two fields). A record is content-addressed by the JCS bytes of this object.

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint's id: SHA-256 of its safetensors file bytes.

role.description: Which network the checkpoint holds; a Preview and a Battle checkpoint are promoted as a pair.

lineage_id.description: A label for the lineage this checkpoint belongs to; informational, the checker never trusts it for independence.

parent.description: The checkpoint this one was initialised from, when there is one (the warm start or the previous generation); absent for a fresh random initialisation.

league_opponents.description: Learned checkpoints it trained against, sorted and unique (a reader rule). Scripted baselines are not listed: they never count for ancestry (C6).

exploiter_target.description: The frozen candidate this checkpoint was trained only to beat, when it is an evaluation exploiter (pool X); absent otherwise.

training_set_hashes.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of each TrainingSet this checkpoint was trained on, sorted and unique (a reader rule).

team_set_manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 of the content-addressed team-set manifest: every team the training drew (protocol C7, T3).

run_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TrainingRunConfig of the run.

learner_state_hash.description: SHA-256 of JCS({tensors_sha256, sidecar}) of the generation's learner state (ADR-010 §1).

encoder_version.description: The encoder the checkpoint was trained with: enc<format>: and the SHA-256 that carries the engine-data table's hash (ADR-010 section 3).

data_class.description: private when any training input was private; a private record is never committed (ADR-008 §5).

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).
